hops.text: The tide surged in an hour ahead of schedule, catching Elias off guard on the pier. The water, a churning shade of slate gray, bit at the air with a biting chill. Standing there, he was struck by a sudden, heavy memory of his father, a man who had spent his life wrestling the sea for a living. The weight of that recollection lingered until he finally turned away, retreating to the warmth of his home to steep a cup of tea.
